async def act(page):
    """
    Close any blocking popup if present, then click the "Add New Rule . . ." button to open the create-new-shopping-cart-price-rule page.
    Clicking "Add New Rule . . ." navigates away from this page, so it is intentionally the last action performed here.
    """
    import re
    import asyncio

    # Try to close a blocking popup if one exists. Try common accessible names, then fall back to Escape.
    try:
        close_btn = page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(r"close", re.I))
        if await close_btn.count() > 0:
            await close_btn.first.click()
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
        else:
            # Try the typical × button label
            close_x = page.get_by_role("button", name="×")
            if await close_x.count() > 0:
                await close_x.first.click()
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
            else:
                # Fallback: press Escape to dismiss modals
                await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
    except Exception:
        # If anything goes wrong closing a popup, ignore and continue — we will still attempt to click the Add New Rule button.
        pass

    # Click the Add New Rule button using the full accessibility path (this will navigate away)
    await page.get_by_role("table").get_by_role("row", name="Shopping Cart Price Rules Add New Rule . . .").get_by_role("cell", name="Add New Rule . . .").get_by_role("button", name="Add New Rule . . .").click()
